wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is the county-branded boxed grid with ~40 data rows, every one empty; its printed footer TOTAL cell carries a slashed-zero glyph = 0. Cover line 1 and line 2 each read a handwritten '0' in all three columns, so the THIS and CUMULATIVE scopes coincide at 0.

expenditures.detail: Form B (p3) is empty; its printed footer TOTAL carries a slashed-zero glyph = 0. That 0 equals the THIS-REPORT cell (0) and NOT the CUMULATIVE cell (571.00, written '571.' with superscript '00'), so on this filing the SCHEDULE is per-period while the module publishes the cumulative figure - reconciles_* is expected to be left blank, which is not a failure. NOTE the scope test is degenerate here: with zero rows the only evidence is the printed schedule total itself. Cover line 4 reads '-571.00' in the LAST and CUMULATIVE columns and '0' in the THIS column.

gates.page_subtotal: p2 rows 0.00 = printed TOTAL (slashed-zero) 0; p3 rows 0.00 = printed TOTAL (slashed-zero) 0. Both gate.
gates.row_count: counted by eye on the 200 dpi renders: p2 and p3 are boxed grids of ~40 ruled data rows each with ZERO inked rows; 0 rows emitted from each. (Not scored with rowbands - there is no ink to score against.)
gates.geometry_proof: not applicable - zero rows emitted, so no geometry pointer was written.
gates.balance_chain: This period: 0 (contrib) - 0 (exp) = 0 change, and cover line 4 THIS = 0. Cumulative: 0 + 0 - 571.00 = -571.00 = cover line 4 CUMULATIVE. Closes exactly. The prior-cycle filing that produced the 571.00 carry-in is not in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain was run.

escalation_note: cover anchor grid (lines 1-3), cover line 4, and both schedule TOTAL cells re-read as 600 dpi crops - needed to separate the handwritten '0' glyphs on the cover from the slashed-Oe glyphs in the schedule TOTAL cells.
